# Test fixtures

Synthetic data for unit and e2e tests. These are **not real paint colors** (apart from
SW Alabaster, #EDEAE0 / LRV 82, taken from the project plan). The "Rodda" rows and the
alternate Alabaster hex in the extra sources exist only to test multi-source merging and
hex-disagreement display.

- `paintdb-sample.json` — generated by `scripts/make-fixture.ts`
- `sources.json` — three sources merged by the e2e build
